problem: A costume maker bought a 50 m bolt of ribbon and cut 23 m from it to trim the dancers' skirts. What length of ribbon remains on the bolt?
follow_up_questions: The choir's robes will need 30 m of ribbon. How many more metres does she have to buy?

problem: What length of fence wire is left on the farmer's coil? The coil held 50 m, and she stretched 23 m of it along the sheep pen.
follow_up_questions: Mending the goat pen will take 30 m of wire. How many extra metres does she need to get?

problem: Kofi's sticker album has 72 spaces, and he has filled 45 of them. How many spaces are still empty?
follow_up_questions: He fills 9 spaces every day. How many days until the album is full?
How many of the empty spaces will he have filled after 2 of those days?
How many spaces will still be empty then?

problem: Lena has learned 45 songs so far from a piano course of 72 songs. What number of songs are still left to learn?
follow_up_questions: Learning 9 songs each week, how many weeks will she need to finish the course?
After 2 of those weeks, how many of the remaining songs will she have learned?
At that point, how many songs will she still have left?

problem: A school bus set off with 36 children aboard. At the first stop, by the library, 12 children got off. How many children were still on the bus?
follow_up_questions: At the park, 8 more children got off. How many children are on the bus now?
Then 5 children got on to ride back. How many children are on the bus at the end?

problem: How many cars remained on the ferry? It left the mainland carrying 36 cars, and 12 of them drove off at the first island.
follow_up_questions: At the second island, another 8 cars drove off. How many cars does the ferry carry now?
Before sailing on, the crew let 5 cars drive aboard. How many cars are on the ferry at the end?

problem: A fish tank at the pet shop was filled with 45 litres of water. During cleaning, Ms Duarte drained 18 litres. How much water is left in the tank?
follow_up_questions: She then adds 20 litres of fresh water. How much water is in the tank now?

problem: Splashing in the garden, the twins tipped 18 litres out of their paddling pool. It had held 45 litres. How much water was still in the pool?
follow_up_questions: Their dad tops it up with 20 litres from the hose. What does the pool hold now?

problem: For a birthday party, a bakery decorated 46 vanilla cupcakes and 29 chocolate cupcakes. How many cupcakes were made?
follow_up_questions: The cupcakes are shared equally onto 5 trays. How many cupcakes go on each tray?
Each tray also gets 4 cookies. How many treats are on one tray?
How many treats are on all 5 trays together?

problem: What is the total number of beads in the craft box, if it holds 46 red beads and 29 blue ones?
follow_up_questions: The beads are divided equally among 5 children. How many beads does each child receive?
Every child is also handed 4 shells. How many beads and shells does one child have?
Counting all 5 children, how many beads and shells were handed out?

problem: On the train to her grandmother's, Priya knitted 14 rows of her scarf. The carriage was nearly empty. Once she arrived, she knitted 23 more rows. How many rows did she knit that day?
How many photos did Tomas take altogether? He snapped 14 at the zoo in the morning. The penguins were his favourite. In the afternoon he took 23 more at the beach.
Kemal and Rosa painted a long banner for the school fair. Kemal painted 58 cm of it and Rosa painted 37 cm. How long is the whole banner?
follow_up_questions: The banner for the bake stall is 18 cm shorter than theirs. How long is that banner?
Find the length of the two banners together.

problem: What is the full length of a paper chain made by two cousins, if Hana's part is 58 cm and Felix's part is 37 cm?
follow_up_questions: Their neighbour made a chain 18 cm shorter. What length is the neighbour's chain?
If the cousins' chain and the neighbour's chain are laid end to end, how long are they altogether?

problem: Two sacks of birdseed sit in the zoo's aviary store. One weighs 16 kg and the other 24 kg. How much birdseed is there in total?
follow_up_questions: Each feeder takes 2 kg of seed. How many feeders can be filled?

problem: Find the total amount of lemonade at Ayo's stand: one cooler holds 16 litres and a second cooler holds 24 litres.
follow_up_questions: If she pours it all into 2 litre jugs, how many jugs will she fill?

problem: The art class stacked a 74 cm box on top of a 49 cm box to build a robot sculpture. How tall was the sculpture?
follow_up_questions: Then they added a head 16 cm tall. How tall is the sculpture now?
Another class built a sculpture 28 cm shorter than that. How tall is the other sculpture?
Once the other class puts a 13 cm stand under theirs, how much shorter is it than the art class's sculpture?

problem: What height do the two pieces reach when a carpenter sets a 74 cm cupboard on top of a 49 cm chest?
follow_up_questions: She fixes a 16 cm wooden crown to the top. How tall is it now?
A second cupboard in her workshop is 28 cm lower than that. What is its height?
If the second cupboard is raised on a 13 cm base, by how much is it still lower than the first?

problem: At the vet's surgery, 13 dogs were waiting at opening time. By midday, owners had brought in 9 more. How many dogs were waiting then?
follow_up_questions: The vet saw 6 of them before lunch. How many dogs were still waiting?
Each dog still waiting needs 2 treats to stay calm. How many treats does the nurse need?

problem: How many watches were waiting for repair by lunch, if Mr Lindqvist had 13 on his bench at opening and customers dropped off 9 more?
follow_up_questions: He mended 6 of them in the afternoon. How many watches still need fixing?
Every unfixed watch needs 2 new batteries. How many batteries must he order?

problem: A window cleaner climbed thirty-four rungs up a tall ladder, paused to wipe her brow, then went up fifteen more rungs to the roof. How many rungs did she climb?
follow_up_questions: Then she went back down twenty rungs. How many rungs above the ground is she now?

problem: How many steps did Ravi climb altogether? He went up 34 stone steps to a lookout, rested on a bench, and climbed 15 more to the summit.
follow_up_questions: On the way down he went 20 steps and stopped to watch a bird. How many steps above the start of the trail is he?

problem: By breakfast, Oskar had laid sixteen tiles on the bathroom floor. The radio was playing his favourite song. After breakfast he laid twenty more tiles. How many tiles has he laid now?
How many links are in Mia's paper chain now? It had 16 links before school. Her little brother kept trying to grab it. After school she added 20 more.
Chiara has twenty-eight seashells in a jar. On a beach walk she finds nine more. How many seashells does she have now?
follow_up_questions: She gives 7 to her best friend. How many seashells does she keep?
She lines up the seashells she kept in rows of 6. How many rows does she make?

problem: How many marbles does Ivo own after the school fair? Before it he had 28, and at the fair he won 9 new ones.
follow_up_questions: He hands 7 marbles to his cousin. How many does he have left?
He sorts those into bags of 6. How many bags can he fill?

problem: A crew is laying a garden path. By Monday they had laid forty-eight rows of paving stones, and on Tuesday they laid fourteen more rows. How many rows of stones have they laid?
follow_up_questions: The finished path will have 80 rows. How many rows are still missing?
The crew lays 6 rows a day. How many more days will the path take?
Each row uses 9 stones. How many stones will the missing rows need?

problem: How many rows of seats are in the stadium stand so far? Builders finished 48 rows last month and 14 rows this month.
follow_up_questions: The stand is planned to have 80 rows. How many rows do they still have to build?
If they build 6 rows a week, how many weeks will that take?
Every row has 9 seats. How many seats will be in the rows still to be built?

problem: A school library got fifty-five new books in its first delivery. Later a second parcel came with twenty-two books. How many new books arrived?
follow_up_questions: Pupils borrowed 9 of them during the week. How many new books are still on the shelves?

problem: What is the total number of sacks of flour the bakery received, if the morning lorry dropped off 55 sacks and the evening lorry brought 22?
follow_up_questions: The bakers used up 9 sacks over the week. How many sacks are left?

problem: A snail crawled 14 cm before lunch and 9 cm after lunch. How far did the snail crawl that day?
follow_up_questions: The next day it crawled only 6 cm. How much farther did it crawl on the first day?
What distance did it crawl over the two days?

problem: How many eggs did Grandpa Musa's hens lay on Monday, if he collected 14 at sunrise and 9 at sunset?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday the hens laid just 6 eggs. How many more eggs were laid on Monday than on Tuesday?
What was the total number of eggs over the two days?

problem: A wheelbarrow held 7 kg of soil. If the gardener shovels 16 kg of compost in as well, how heavy will the load be?
What will Amira's suitcase weigh after she packs 16 kg of clothes into it? Right now it holds 7 kg of books.
A small aquarium had 8 litres of water in it. Darius poured in 6 litres, then his mother added 5 litres more. How much water does the aquarium hold now?
follow_up_questions: When full, the aquarium takes 25 litres. How much more water could still go in?

problem: How much juice is in the punch bowl now? It started with 8 cups, then Keiko added 6 cups and her uncle stirred in 5 cups more.
follow_up_questions: The bowl holds 25 cups when it is full. How many more cups of juice would fit?

problem: A beach flagpole is made from two sections, each 85 cm long, screwed end to end. How tall is the joined pole?
follow_up_questions: The bottom 20 cm of the pole is buried in the sand. How much of the pole sticks up above the sand?

problem: What length of track does Lucia get when she joins two pieces of toy train track, each 85 cm long?
follow_up_questions: A tunnel covers 20 cm of the track. How much of the track is outside the tunnel?

problem: A sunflower in Tariq's garden was 27 cm tall. Over the summer its height doubled. How tall is the sunflower now?
After her birthday, Elif's sticker collection was twice as big as before. Before, she had 27 stickers. How many does she have now?
The drama club's wardrobe held 26 costumes. A theatre in the city gave them 15 more. Everyone clapped when the boxes arrived. How many costumes does the club have now?
follow_up_questions: Four of the costumes have torn sleeves. How many costumes are in good shape?

problem: How many footballs does the sports club have now? Its storeroom held 26 balls before a local bakery donated 15 more. The coach put a photo of the gift on the notice board.
follow_up_questions: It turns out 4 of the balls are flat. How many balls can be used?

problem: There was 36 ml of glue in the art room's glue pot. Ms Haddad poured in 48 ml from a big bottle. How much glue does the pot hold now?
follow_up_questions: Each model needs 4 ml of glue, and the class builds 9 models. How much glue is left in the pot?
How many more models could be built with the glue that is left?
Counting the 9 models already built, how many models could the glue in the pot have made in all?

problem: How much syrup is in the cafe's pancake jug now, if it held 36 ml and Arjun added 48 ml from a new bottle?
follow_up_questions: A pancake stack gets 4 ml of syrup, and Arjun serves 9 stacks. How much syrup remains in the jug?
How many more stacks can he serve with the remaining syrup?
Together with the 9 stacks he already served, how many stacks could the jug's syrup cover?

problem: At the ice cream van in the park, each of the two serving windows had a queue of 8 children at 3 o'clock. How many children were queuing altogether?
follow_up_questions: Then 5 children got tired of waiting and left. How many were still in the queues?

problem: How many people were waiting at the museum's two ticket desks, if each desk had a line of 8 visitors? The museum had opened 2 hours earlier.
follow_up_questions: Then 5 visitors gave up and went home. How many were still in line?

problem: Painting the long wall around the school yard is a job for a team of 4 painters. They covered 12 m in Monday's morning shift and 9 m in the afternoon shift, then 14 m on Tuesday morning and 7 m on Tuesday afternoon. What length of wall is painted so far?
follow_up_questions: The whole wall is 75 m long. How many metres are still unpainted?
If the team paints 11 m each day, how many more days will they need?

problem: How far have the trail volunteers cleared so far? There are 6 of them. On Saturday they cleared 12 m of path before noon and 9 m after noon; on Sunday, 14 m before noon and 7 m after.
follow_up_questions: The whole trail is 75 m long. How much of it is still to be cleared?
Clearing 11 m a day, how many more days will the volunteers need?

problem: A tailor had a ribbon 92 cm long. She snipped off 15 cm to make a bow for a hat. How long is the ribbon now?
follow_up_questions: Next she cut 25 cm for a belt loop. What length of ribbon is left?
She shares the rest equally among 4 dresses. How long is each dress's piece?

problem: How long is the wooden strip in the woodwork room now? It was 92 cm until Mr Petrov sawed off 15 cm for a shelf peg.
follow_up_questions: He then saws off 25 cm for a handle. What length is left?
The leftover strip is cut into 4 equal pieces for picture frames. How long is each piece?

problem: The pencil marks on the kitchen door show that little Lars has grown 9 cm since his last birthday. Today he measures 86 cm. How tall was he on his last birthday?
follow_up_questions: When he was born he was 52 cm long. How much did he grow from birth to his last birthday?

problem: How tall was the cherry tree last spring? Since then it has grown 9 cm, and now it stands 86 cm tall.
follow_up_questions: The tree was 52 cm tall when it was planted. How much did it grow between planting and last spring?

problem: Mrs Yilmaz bought a sack of potting soil for her balcony plants. She used 14 kg filling the pots and had 23 kg left in the sack. How much soil was in the sack at the start?
How much sand did the bag hold before Kenta filled the sandpit? He tipped in 14 kg, and there were still 23 kg in the bag afterwards.
A tractor came into the farm market with 64 kg of apples. After some were unloaded at the stall, it left with 29 kg still on board. How many kilograms of apples were unloaded?
follow_up_questions: The unloaded apples are packed into bags of 5 kg. How many bags are filled?
A bag sells for 3 dollars. How much money will the bags bring in?

problem: What weight of sand did a builder's van tip out at the playground? It arrived with 64 kg and drove away with 29 kg still in the back.
follow_up_questions: The tipped sand is shovelled into buckets of 5 kg each. How many buckets is that?
The playground pays 3 dollars per bucket. What does the sand cost?

problem: Ali cut a sunflower from the garden with a stem 48 cm long. After he trimmed it, the stem measured 35 cm. How many centimetres did he trim off?
follow_up_questions: He stands the sunflower in a jug 30 cm tall. How much of the stem rises above the jug?

problem: How many centimetres did Nils cut off the bamboo cane? It came from the garden centre 48 cm long, and after cutting it measured 35 cm.
follow_up_questions: He stands the cane in an umbrella stand 30 cm tall. How much of it pokes out of the top?

problem: The class is keeping track of a growing puppy. It weighed 15 kg in March and 23 kg in May. By how much did its weight go up?
follow_up_questions: If it gains the same amount over the next two months, how heavy will it be?

problem: How many centimetres did the snow rise overnight? At bedtime the snow in the yard was 15 cm deep, and by morning it was 23 cm deep.
follow_up_questions: If the same amount falls again tonight, how deep will the snow be?

problem: A bathtub had 18 litres of water in it. The bathroom mirror was all steamed up. Mum ran the tap until the tub held 45 litres. How much water did she add?
How many litres did the gardener add to the rain barrel? It held 18 litres at first, and he filled it from the hose until it held 45 litres. A frog was sitting on the lid.
At the ice festival, a block of ice stood 26 cm tall in the morning sun. By lunchtime it had melted down to 17 cm. How many centimetres had melted?
follow_up_questions: The next afternoon it melted another 8 cm. How tall was it then?
How much of the block melted over the two days together?

problem: How much shorter did the log get? A log 26 cm long burned in the fireplace until 17 cm was left.
follow_up_questions: The next cold evening another 8 cm burned. How long was the log then?
How much of the log burned over the two evenings?

problem: A string for a necklace has 98 beads. Freya slides off 6 beads to make it shorter, then takes off 6 more after trying it on. How many beads are left on the string?
follow_up_questions: She adds all the removed beads to a bracelet that has 71 beads. How many beads does the bracelet have now?

problem: How many links remain in the paper chain? It started with 98 links; Hana tore off 6 to fit it over the door, then tore off 6 more to fit the window.
follow_up_questions: She glues all the removed links onto her sister's chain of 71 links. How many links does her sister's chain have now?

problem: The school library hopes to collect 80 used books for its sale. So far, 46 books have been donated. How many more books does it need?
follow_up_questions: On Thursday, 18 more books come in. How many books are still needed?
On Friday, families bring 21 books. By how many books did the library beat its goal?
How many books were collected in all?

problem: How many trees are still to be planted, if the town's goal for the new park is 80 trees and volunteers have planted 46 so far?
follow_up_questions: On Saturday morning, 18 more trees go in. How many are still needed?
On Sunday, the volunteers plant 21 trees. By how many trees did they go past the goal?
What is the total number of trees planted?

problem: The art teacher had 40 sheets of coloured card. She handed 12 sheets to the Red group for their posters. How many sheets did she have left?
follow_up_questions: Then the Blue group got 9 sheets. How many sheets does the teacher have now?
The Red group splits its sheets into 3 equal piles. How many sheets are in each pile?

problem: How much fabric did the costume designer have left after giving 12 m of her 40 m roll to the dancers?
follow_up_questions: Next the singers took 9 m. How much fabric is left on the roll?
The dancers cut their piece into 3 equal lengths. How long is each length?

problem: At the end of the market day, the cheese seller had 19 kg of cheese left. She had set up that morning with 58 kg. Work out how much cheese she sold.
How many kilograms of apples did the orchard stand sell, if it started the day with 58 kg and had 19 kg left when it closed?
This month the swimming pool gave lessons to 72 people. Of these, 35 were children and the rest were grown-ups. How many grown-ups took lessons?
follow_up_questions: Next month the pool expects 9 more grown-ups than this month. How many grown-ups is that?

problem: Out of the 72 visitors to the museum's dinosaur hall this morning, 35 were students. How many visitors were not students?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon there were 9 more non-students than in the morning. How many non-students came in the afternoon?

problem: The farm's water tank held 39 litres. After the pump ran for a while, it held 87 litres. How many litres were pumped in?
follow_up_questions: The farmer then filled 4 troughs with 9 litres each from the tank. How much water was left in it?

problem: How much lemonade did the cafe make this morning? The big dispenser had 39 cups in it at opening, and after Chloe mixed a new batch it held 87 cups.
follow_up_questions: Then she poured 4 jugs of 9 cups each for a party. How many cups were left in the dispenser?

problem: A banner for the class door is made from two strips of paper, one 34 cm long and the other 29 cm long. If they are taped end to end, how long is the banner?
What total distance does a frog cover if its first jump is 34 cm and its second jump, in the same direction, is 29 cm?
Ana's music lesson had two parts: scales took 37 minutes and new songs took 48 minutes. How long was the lesson?
follow_up_questions: Of that time, her teacher spent 39 minutes playing. How many minutes did Ana play?
How many more minutes did Ana play than her teacher?

problem: Find how long the school play lasted if the first act ran for 37 minutes and the second act for 48 minutes.
follow_up_questions: The main character was on stage for 39 of those minutes. For how many minutes was she off stage?
How many more minutes was she off stage than on stage?

problem: The floor lamp is 47 cm tall without its shade. With the shade on, it is 78 cm tall. How tall is the shade?
follow_up_questions: Then Aiko stands the lamp on a 12 cm block. How tall is the lamp now?

problem: How tall is the top part of the sandcastle? Without its tower the castle was 47 cm high, and with the tower added it stood 78 cm high.
follow_up_questions: A 12 cm flag is stuck in the top. How tall is the sandcastle with the flag?

problem: A toy box in the nursery already had some blocks in it. Jada tipped in 27 blocks, and then the box held 63 blocks. How many blocks were in the box before Jada came?
follow_up_questions: The box can hold 95 blocks. How many more fit in it now?
Her brother adds 15 blocks. How many more blocks fit after that?

problem: How many litres were in the swimming pool's top-up tank this morning? The keeper pumped in 27 litres and the tank then held 63 litres.
follow_up_questions: The tank holds 95 litres when full. How much more water fits in it now?
The keeper pumps in another 15 litres. How much space is left after that?

problem: The drama club used 18 m of cloth to make the curtains for their puppet theatre. The curtains were bright purple. Afterwards, 23 m of cloth was left on the roll. How long was the roll at the start?
How long was the roll of wrapping paper before Kwasi wrapped the presents? He used 18 m, and 23 m remained on the roll. His little sister helped with the bows.
Fresh snow fell all night on the ski slope, adding 18 cm to the 45 cm that already lay there. What is the depth of the snow now?
follow_up_questions: During the warm days that followed, it became 14 cm shallower. How deep was it then?
How much deeper is it than before the night of fresh snow?
The ski school needs 60 cm of snow. How many more centimetres does it need?

problem: How high is the sand pile in the playground? It was 45 cm, and a truck dumped enough sand to make it 18 cm higher.
follow_up_questions: Over the week the children flattened it by 14 cm. How high was it then?
How much higher is it than before the truck came?
The playground wants a pile 60 cm high. How many more centimetres of sand does it need?

problem: A farmer picked 76 peaches, but 28 of them were bruised and had to be thrown away. How many good peaches were left?
follow_up_questions: The good peaches are packed in boxes of 6. How many boxes are there?
Each box sells for 5 dollars. How much money will all the boxes bring?

problem: How many cookies were fine after Mrs Kowalski burnt 28 of the 76 cookies she baked?
follow_up_questions: She puts the good cookies in bags of 6. How many bags does she fill?
She sells every bag for 5 dollars at the bake sale. What do the bags earn?

problem: A gardener has a 46 m hose and a 38 m hose. Joined together, how long are they?
follow_up_questions: By how much is the first hose longer than the second?
From the tap to the far fence the garden is 99 m long. How many metres short of the fence do the joined hoses fall?
She fills the gap with extension pieces 5 m long. How many pieces does she need?

problem: What is the total length of the two trains standing at the station, if one is 46 m long and the other 38 m long?
follow_up_questions: How much longer is the first train?
The platform is 99 m long. If the trains park end to end along it, how many metres of platform are left free?
Benches 5 m long are placed along the free part. How many benches fit?

problem: A charity walk is 42 km long. The first 17 km go through the town, and the rest goes through a forest. How long is the forest part?
follow_up_questions: Mei has walked 9 km through the forest so far. How much of the forest part is still ahead of her?

problem: How many kilometres of Aditi's train journey run along the coast? The trip is 42 km in total, and the first 17 km pass through farmland.
follow_up_questions: The train has gone 9 km along the coast so far. How much of the coastal part is left?

problem: The old slide at the water park is 19 m tall. The new slide is 13 m taller. How tall is the new slide?
follow_up_questions: The water park's lookout tower is 40 m tall. How far below the top of the tower is the top of the new slide?
How many metres below the top of the tower is the top of the old slide?

problem: How high does the new kite fly? The old kite reached 19 m, and the new one flies 13 m higher.
follow_up_questions: A tall tree nearby is 40 m tall. How far below the treetop does the new kite stay?
How far below the treetop did the old kite fly?

problem: A pet shop had 63 kg of dog food in its storeroom. Customers bought 17 kg of it in the morning and 25 kg in the afternoon. What weight of dog food remains?
follow_up_questions: The shop owner splits what is left equally into 3 sacks. How much is in each sack?

problem: How much flour is left in the bakery's bin? It held 63 kg on Saturday; the bakers used 17 kg for cakes and 25 kg for bread.
follow_up_questions: The bakers divide what is left equally into 3 tubs. How much flour goes in each tub?

problem: Kai's goal for the reading prize is 80 pages. After reading 34 pages on Saturday and another 27 on Sunday, how many pages does he still need?
How many more kilometres must the cyclist ride to finish her 80 km charity challenge, if she rode 34 km on the first day and 27 km on the second?

Leo's music player had some playing time left on its battery. He plugged it in, which added 27 minutes, and now it can play for 64 minutes. The cable was tangled in knots. How many minutes of playing time did it have before he plugged it in?
follow_up_questions: His bus ride to the coast lasts 75 minutes. How many more minutes of playing time does the player need to last the whole ride?

problem: How much time was left on the parking meter before Mrs Abara added coins? The coins added 27 minutes, and the meter now shows 64 minutes. A pigeon sat on top of the meter.
follow_up_questions: She plans to stay in town for 75 minutes. How many more minutes must she add to the meter?

problem: After the children scooped 29 kg of sand out of the sandbox for their castles, 48 kg remained. What did the sandbox hold before they started?
How many kilograms of rice did the restaurant have at first? The cooks used 29 kg this week and 48 kg is left in the store.
Four ribbons hang from the maypole at the village fair, which starts at 2 o'clock. They measure 15 m, 20 m, 15 m and 25 m. Tied end to end, how long would they be?
follow_up_questions: The path round the green is 90 m. How much more ribbon is needed to go all the way round?
The organisers find a 20 m ribbon in a box and tie it on. How long is the ribbon now?

problem: What length of wire does a farmer get by joining his four rolls of 15 m, 20 m, 15 m and 25 m? His barn, where the rolls are kept, also holds 8 calves.
follow_up_questions: The field he wants to fence is 90 m around. How much more wire does he need?
His neighbour lends him a 20 m roll, which he joins on. How long is his wire now?

problem: Post office clerks sealed parcels with 47 m of tape from a 90 m roll. What length of tape is still on the roll?
How much yarn does Grandma Teresa have left? Her ball started at 90 m, and she has knitted 47 m of it into a scarf.
A taxi drove 58 km before lunch and 64 km after lunch. What distance did it cover that day?
follow_up_questions: The day before, it covered 17 km less. How far did it drive the day before?
What is its distance for the two days together?
On the third day it drove 73 km. Find the total for all three days.

problem: How far did the school bus travel on Tuesday, if it went 58 km on the morning run and 64 km on the afternoon run?
follow_up_questions: On Monday it travelled 17 km less than on Tuesday. How far did it go on Monday?
What distance did it travel across Monday and Tuesday?
Wednesday's runs added up to 73 km. How far has the bus gone over the three days?

problem: Nadia had forty stickers in her book. If she buys fifteen more, how many stickers will she have?
follow_up_questions: She gives 9 stickers to each of 3 friends. How many stickers are left after that?
Then her aunt sends her twelve more. How many stickers does she have now?
How many fewer stickers is that than right after she bought the new ones?

problem: The bakery's shelf holds 40 loaves. How many loaves will be on it after the baker brings out 15 fresh ones?
follow_up_questions: Customers buy 9 loaves in each of the next 3 hours. How many loaves remain?
Then the baker adds 12 more loaves. How many are on the shelf now?
How many fewer loaves is that than just after the fresh ones came out?

problem: Joseph's running app showed thirty-two kilometres for the month. On Saturday he ran eighteen kilometres, and on Sunday twenty-five more. What does the app show now?
follow_up_questions: He earns a medal when the app reaches 90 km. How many more kilometres until the medal?
If he runs 5 km each day, how many days will that take?

problem: What total does the scooter's trip meter show now? It read 32 km before the weekend; Hira rode 18 km on Saturday and 25 km on Sunday.
follow_up_questions: The scooter needs a check-up at 90 km. How many kilometres are left until then?
Riding 5 km a day, how many days will it be until the check-up?

problem: A honey seller at the farmers' market had $57 in her tin at lunchtime and $83 at the end of the day. How much did she take in after lunch?
follow_up_questions: She then pays $25 for her market pitch. How much of the tin's money does she keep?

problem: How many dollars did the school book fair make in the afternoon? The till showed $57 at lunch and $83 when the fair closed.
follow_up_questions: The school then pays $25 to the van driver who brought the books. How much of the till money is left?

problem: Before dinner, Ana's line of dominoes had 28 pieces. After dinner she kept adding until it had 54. How many dominoes did she add after dinner?
How many beads did Kofi thread onto his necklace in the evening? It had 28 beads in the afternoon and 54 by bedtime.
Ines has $27 in her piggy bank. The skateboard she wants costs $42. How much more money does she need?
follow_up_questions: Her uncle gives her the missing amount plus an extra $9. How much does he give her?

problem: How many entries did the school art show get, if pupils sent in 35 paintings and 65 drawings?
follow_up_questions: The judges turned down 16 entries. How many entries are left?

problem: In March a knitting group finished 14 hats at its first meeting, 9 at its second and 21 at its third. Tea was served at every meeting. How many hats did the group finish that month?
follow_up_questions: In April they want to finish 50 hats. How many more is that than in March?
If they meet that target, how many hats will they have finished over the two months?

problem: How many kilometres did the cycling club ride this week? The Monday ride was 14 km, the Wednesday ride 9 km and the Saturday ride 21 km. Everyone wore bright yellow vests.
follow_up_questions: Next week they plan to ride 50 km. How many more kilometres is that than this week?
If they manage it, what will the total be for the two weeks?

problem: Darius wants an atlas for $32 and a cookbook for $21 from the bookshop. What would the two books cost?
follow_up_questions: He has $60. How much is left after he buys them?

problem: How much do a $21 rain jacket and a pair of $32 boots cost together at the outdoor shop?
follow_up_questions: Ingrid has $60. How much will she have left after buying them?

problem: A bookshop sold 47 copies of a new adventure book on its first day and 45 the next day. How many copies did it sell over the two days?
follow_up_questions: It had 99 copies in stock before the book came out. How many copies are left?
A van brings 4 boxes with 12 copies in each. How many copies does the shop have now?

problem: How many tickets did the funfair sell over its first weekend if it sold 47 on opening day and 45 on the day after?
follow_up_questions: It had printed 99 tickets. How many tickets are left?
The office prints 4 more sheets of 12 tickets. How many tickets are there now?

problem: Preparing the classroom for the new school year, Mr Hale bought pens for $18, books for $26, a rug for $22 and plants for $9. What did he spend?
follow_up_questions: He had planned to spend $90. How much of his budget is left?

problem: How much did the Silva family spend getting ready for their camping trip? Torches cost $18, sleeping mats $26, a cooler $22 and matches and candles $9.
follow_up_questions: Their budget was $90. What is left of it?

problem: A school collects old batteries in three boxes. After a month, the first box held 27 batteries, the second 34 and the third 41. How many batteries were collected?
follow_up_questions: A truck takes away 52 of them for recycling. How many batteries are left?
The rest are packed equally into 5 bags. How many batteries go in each bag?

problem: How many baskets of apples did the orchard pick if the first row of trees gave 27 baskets, the second 34 and the third 41?
follow_up_questions: The orchard sells 52 baskets at the market. How many baskets are left?
The rest are shared out among 5 families. How many baskets does each family get?

problem: Some ducks were swimming on the pond. When a dog barked, 12 of them flew away, and 27 stayed on the water. How many ducks were swimming at first?
How many people were on the bus before the stop at the library, if 12 people got off there and 27 people were still on board?
At the school book fair, the storybooks brought in $58 and the comics brought in $67. How much did the fair bring in?
follow_up_questions: The school spends $48 on a new bookcase. How much money is left?
Then a teacher donates $15. What does the school have now?

problem: How much did the garden club make at its plant sale, if the tomato plants made $58 and the herbs made $67?
follow_up_questions: The club spends $48 on a new hose. How much is left?
Later a neighbour gives $15. How much does the club have now?

problem: At a sports camp, Hugo played 13 tennis matches, 11 table tennis matches and 17 badminton matches. How many matches did he play?
follow_up_questions: He won 25 of them. How many did he not win?
Every win gave him 2 points. How many points did his wins earn?
A gold medal needs 60 points. How many more points does he need?

problem: How many quizzes did Selma take part in this term? She did 13 maths quizzes, 11 science quizzes and 17 spelling quizzes.
follow_up_questions: She came first in 25 of them. In how many did she not come first?
Each first place earned 2 stars. How many stars did she earn?
A certificate needs 60 stars. How many more stars does she need?

problem: The cable car took 32 skiers up the mountain in the morning and 29 in the afternoon. How many skiers rode it?
follow_up_questions: Each ride costs $3. How much did the cable car collect?
The owner spends $45 of that on new cables. How much is left?

problem: How many passengers were on the river boat, if 32 sat on the top deck and 29 sat below?
follow_up_questions: A trip costs $3 per passenger. How much money did the boat take?
The captain pays $45 for fuel out of it. How much is left?

problem: A greengrocer opened with 38 melons on her stall. At ten o'clock a lorry dropped off 74 more. How many melons does she have now?
How many bottles of water are in the gym's fridge now? Coach Amal put in 74 new bottles to join the 38 already inside.
Ms Rivera took $27 out of the class piggy bank to buy art paper. Before that, it held $52. How much is in the piggy bank now?
follow_up_questions: Pupils then put in $18 more. How much does the piggy bank hold now?

problem: How much is left in the tip jar at the cafe after the owner removes $27 of the $52 inside to buy coffee beans?
follow_up_questions: Customers then add $18. What is in the jar now?

problem: The barn had 47 bales of hay. During a snowy week the farmer fed 33 of them to the cows. How many bales are left in the barn?
follow_up_questions: He buys 24 more bales. How many bales are in the barn now?
The cows eat 2 bales each day. For how many days will the hay last?

problem: How many candles are left in the box, if it held 47 and the family burned 33 during a week of power cuts?
follow_up_questions: They buy 24 more candles. How many are in the box now?
They burn 2 candles each night. How many nights will the candles last?

problem: At the school sports day, 46 children started the long-distance race. By the finish, only 18 were still running. How many children had stopped?
follow_up_questions: Every child who stopped got a $2 snack voucher. What were the vouchers worth altogether?

problem: How many dancers had sat down by the end of the dance marathon? It began with 46 dancers, and 18 were still dancing at the end.
follow_up_questions: Each dancer who sat down was given a $2 drink token. What were the tokens worth in total?

problem: Arjun went to the book fair with $63 and came home with $17. How much did he spend at the fair?
follow_up_questions: His friend spent $9 less than Arjun. How much did his friend spend?
How much did the two boys spend in all?
Next year Arjun wants to bring twice as much money as he brought this year. How much is that?

problem: What did Freya spend at the aquarium, if she arrived with $63 and left with $17?
follow_up_questions: Her brother spent $9 less than she did. What did her brother spend?
How much did the brother and sister spend together?
On her next visit Freya plans to bring double the money she brought this time. How much will that be?

problem: At the school jumble sale, Sana sold 13 of her 32 comic books. The sale raised money for new goalposts. How many comics does Sana still own?
How many crayons are left in Theo's box? It held 32 crayons until he lent 13 to his classmates. The box has a picture of a lion on it.
Roller skates cost Hugo $23 out of the $54 he had saved. How much of his savings does he have left?
follow_up_questions: He then buys knee pads for $18. How much money does he have now?

problem: How much is left of Pania's $54 birthday money after she spends $23 on a paint set?
follow_up_questions: Then she buys a sketchbook for $18. How much money remains?

problem: Laila's colouring book had 70 pictures still to colour. Over the weekend she coloured 45 of them. How many pictures are still uncoloured?
follow_up_questions: On Monday she colours 17 more. How many pictures are left?
Her brother colours the last pictures, 2 at a time. How many turns does he need?

problem: How many seeds are still to be planted, if the gardener had 70 to sow and planted 45 on Saturday?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday he plants 17 more. How many seeds are left?
His daughter plants the rest, 2 seeds in each hole. How many holes does she fill?

problem: An orchard truck brought 39 boxes of cherries to the market, and 17 boxes were sold in the first hour. How many boxes were left to sell?
follow_up_questions: Later, each remaining box sold for $9. How much money did those sales bring in?

problem: How many trays of muffins did the bakery still have to sell after selling 17 of its 39 trays before lunch?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon each tray left sold for $9. What did the afternoon sales bring in?

problem: A ski jacket cost Lena $65. She had $78 before buying it. What is left of her money?
follow_up_questions: She also buys gloves for $9. How much is left after that?
Her dad gives her $20 for lift tickets. How much does she have now?

problem: How much money does Kai have left from $78 after paying $65 for a new bike helmet and lights?
follow_up_questions: He also gets a bell for $9. How much does he have after that?
His grandma sends him $20. How much money does he have now?

problem: The school ordered 75 T-shirts for sports day and handed out 48 of them to pupils. How many T-shirts were left over?
follow_up_questions: The leftover T-shirts are sold for $3 each. What money do they bring in?

problem: How many balloons were not given out, if the shop owner blew up 75 balloons and gave 48 to children at the grand opening?
follow_up_questions: She sells the rest for $3 each. How much money does that bring?

problem: The art room had 95 sheets of card in its cupboard. Making birthday cards, the pupils used 57 of them. How many sheets remain?
follow_up_questions: A parent brings in a pack of 22 sheets. How many sheets are in the cupboard now?
Each pop-up book needs 6 sheets. How many pop-up books can the pupils make with the sheets in the cupboard?
Each pop-up book sells for $8 at the school fair. How much money would those books bring in?

problem: How many eggs are left in the bakery's crates, if there were 95 eggs and the bakers used 57 for cakes?
follow_up_questions: A farmer delivers 22 more eggs. How many eggs are there now?
Each batch of pancakes takes 6 eggs. How many batches can the bakers make?
Each batch sells for $8. How much money would all those batches bring in?

problem: Yuki took $64 on a school trip to the city. A museum ticket and lunch used up $47 of it. The bus had a broken heater. How much money does she have left?
How much money does Ben still have? He brought $64 on the beach holiday, and hiring a surfboard cost him $47. The waves were huge that week.
There are 92 seats in the school theatre. With the show about to start, 37 of them are still empty. How many tickets were sold?
follow_up_questions: A ticket costs $9. How much money has the theatre taken in?
Renting the stage lights costs $95. How much money is left after paying for them?

problem: How many places on the coach trip have been booked? The coaches have 92 places in all, and 37 are still free.
follow_up_questions: Each place costs $9. How much money has come in?
The driver's fee is $95. How much money is left after paying it?

problem: After a big clear-out, only 19 toys are left in Selim's toy box. It used to hold 74. How many toys did he take out?
follow_up_questions: He sells the toys he took out for 3 dollars each. How many dollars does he get?

problem: How many letters did the postman deliver? His bag had 74 letters at the start of his round, and 19 are left now.
follow_up_questions: Each delivered letter had 3 stamps on it. How many stamps were on the delivered letters?

problem: The cake sale put $18 into the school charity box, bringing it to $83. How much money was in the box before the cake sale?
follow_up_questions: The school takes $45 out of the box for a charity gift. How much is left in it?
The rest buys books for the hospital at $2 each. How many books is that?

problem: How much was in Ali's piggy bank before his birthday? His grandmother put in $18, and now the piggy bank holds $83.
follow_up_questions: Ali takes $45 out to buy a scooter. How much is left in the piggy bank?
He spends the rest on comics at $2 each. How many comics can he buy?

problem: When Hamza walked into the zoo, his wallet held $66. When he left, it held $48. How much did his zoo visit cost?
What did Elena spend at the funfair, if she had $66 when she arrived and $48 at the end of the night?
A football usually costs $44. Today it is $16 cheaper. What is today's price?
follow_up_questions: Amara buys the football and also a pump for $19. How much does she spend?
She pays with $50. What change does she get?
Her brother pays her back half of the football's sale price. How much does he give her?

problem: How much is a $44 jacket in the sale, if $16 is taken off the price?
follow_up_questions: Rafi buys the jacket and a scarf for $19. What does he spend?
He hands over $50. How much change does he get?
His mum pays back half of what the jacket cost in the sale. How much does she give him?
